late_lesson.content: Late lesson zebracrane: a hive member must renew its lease before every mutation, because a stale lease lets an older generation write over a newer claim. This lesson also mentions agentihooks-bundle in passing.

historical.content: Historical entry quillfern written before project attribution existed: restart the tick by its own process id, never by pattern.

superseded.title: Tick runs every five minutes
superseded.content: The swarm tick runs every five minutes so ledger writes stay cheap.

current.title: Tick runs every minute
current.content: The swarm tick runs every minute; it replaces the five minute cadence.

late_lesson.content: Late lesson otterlamp: never prune a producer after a scan read error, because the keep set then misses every entry of the unreadable log. It names antoncore only as a deployment target.

historical.content: Historical entry mossgrain from before attribution: the embeddings schema dimension must match the configured model.

superseded.title: One brain stack per host
superseded.content: Each host runs exactly one brain stack with fixed container names.

current.title: Brain instances carry their own names
current.content: Every brain instance names its containers after itself so two can share a host.
